document_packs_used_check.name: document_packs_used_check
document_packs_used_check.value: size > 0 AND used >= 0 AND used <= size

payments_method_check.name: payments_method_check
payments_method_check.value: method IS NULL OR method IN ('SPI_TRANSFER', 'PAYPHONE_CARD')

payments_rejection_check.name: payments_rejection_check
payments_rejection_check.value: rejection_reason IS NULL OR rejection_reason IN ('AMOUNT_MISMATCH', 'TRANSFER_NOT_FOUND', 'WRONG_ACCOUNT', 'ILLEGIBLE_PROOF', 'DUPLICATE_SUBMISSION', 'OTHER')

payments_amounts_check.name: payments_amounts_check
payments_amounts_check.value: base_amount >= 0 AND iva_amount >= 0 AND iva_rate >= 0 AND total_amount = base_amount + iva_amount

payments_target_check.name: payments_target_check
payments_target_check.value:
CASE purpose
            WHEN 'INITIAL' THEN target_plan_id IS NOT NULL AND target_interval IS NOT NULL
            WHEN 'TIER_CHANGE' THEN target_plan_id IS NOT NULL AND target_interval IS NOT NULL
            WHEN 'SEAT_CHANGE' THEN target_seats IS NOT NULL AND target_seats >= 0
            WHEN 'DOCUMENT_PACK' THEN pack_size > 0
            WHEN 'ADD_ON' THEN target_module_id IS NOT NULL
            ELSE true
          END

payments_rejected_check.name: payments_rejected_check
payments_rejected_check.value: status <> 'REJECTED' OR rejection_reason IS NOT NULL

payments_period_check.name: payments_period_check
payments_period_check.value: period_end IS NULL OR period_end > period_start

payphone_transactions_resolved_check.name: payphone_transactions_resolved_check
payphone_transactions_resolved_check.value:
(resolved_at IS NULL) = (resolution_note IS NULL)
          AND (resolved_at IS NULL OR status IN ('DUPLICATE', 'ERROR'))

prices_shape_check.name: prices_shape_check
prices_shape_check.value:
CASE kind
            WHEN 'PLAN' THEN plan_id IS NOT NULL AND module_id IS NULL AND pack_size IS NULL
            WHEN 'MODULE' THEN module_id IS NOT NULL AND plan_id IS NULL AND pack_size IS NULL
            WHEN 'SEAT' THEN plan_id IS NULL AND module_id IS NULL AND pack_size IS NULL
            WHEN 'PACK' THEN pack_size > 0 AND plan_id IS NULL AND module_id IS NULL
          END

prices_withdrawn_check.name: prices_withdrawn_check
prices_withdrawn_check.value: amount IS NOT NULL OR kind = 'PACK'

prices_published_check.name: prices_published_check
prices_published_check.value: (status = 'PUBLISHED') = (effective_on IS NOT NULL AND published_at IS NOT NULL)

bulk_batch_items_outcome_check.name: bulk_batch_items_outcome_check
bulk_batch_items_outcome_check.value: (status = 'CREATED') = (document_id IS NOT NULL) AND (status = 'FAILED') = (error_code IS NOT NULL)

document_lines_credit_kind_check.name: document_lines_credit_kind_check
document_lines_credit_kind_check.value: credit_kind IS NULL OR (source_position IS NOT NULL AND credit_kind IN ('RETURN', 'AMOUNT'))

document_lines_amounts_check.name: document_lines_amounts_check
document_lines_amounts_check.value: quantity > 0 AND unit_price >= 0 AND discount >= 0 AND base >= 0 AND iva >= 0

documents_related_check.name: documents_related_check
documents_related_check.value:
related_document_id IS DISTINCT FROM id
        AND (document_type <> '01' OR related_document_id IS NULL)
        AND (document_type <> '04' OR related_document_id IS NOT NULL)

email_templates_lengths_check.name: email_templates_lengths_check
email_templates_lengths_check.value: length(heading) <= 200 AND length(body) <= 2000 AND length(button) <= 60 AND length(footer) <= 500

email_templates_filled_check.name: email_templates_filled_check
email_templates_filled_check.value: length(trim(subject)) > 0 AND length(trim(heading)) > 0 AND length(trim(body)) > 0 AND length(trim(button)) > 0

plan_limits_pending_check.name: plan_limits_pending_check
plan_limits_pending_check.value: (pending_from IS NULL) = (pending_value IS NULL) AND (pending_value IS NULL OR pending_value >= 0)

subscription_items_shape_check.name: subscription_items_shape_check
subscription_items_shape_check.value:
CASE kind
            WHEN 'MODULE' THEN module_id IS NOT NULL AND feature_key IS NULL AND limit_value IS NULL
            WHEN 'LIMIT' THEN module_id IS NULL AND feature_key IS NOT NULL
          END

subscription_items_complimentary_check.name: subscription_items_complimentary_check
subscription_items_complimentary_check.value: complimentary = (complimentary_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT complimentary OR kind = 'MODULE')

subscriptions_period_check.name: subscriptions_period_check
subscriptions_period_check.value: period_end IS NULL OR period_end > period_start

subscriptions_seats_check.name: subscriptions_seats_check
subscriptions_seats_check.value: extra_seats >= 0 AND (pending_seats IS NULL OR pending_seats >= 0)

subscriptions_pending_interval_check.name: subscriptions_pending_interval_check
subscriptions_pending_interval_check.value: pending_interval IS NULL OR pending_interval IN ('MONTHLY', 'YEARLY')

tenant_feature_overrides_shape_check.name: tenant_feature_overrides_shape_check
tenant_feature_overrides_shape_check.value:
CASE effect
            WHEN 'LIMIT' THEN feature_kind = 'LIMIT'
            ELSE feature_kind = 'BOOLEAN' AND limit_value IS NULL
          END

clients_payment_term_check.name: clients_payment_term_check
clients_payment_term_check.value: (payment_term IS NULL) = (payment_term_unit IS NULL) AND (payment_term IS NULL OR payment_term > 0)

products_price_check.name: products_price_check
products_price_check.value: price >= 0 AND (cost IS NULL OR cost >= 0)

providers_payment_term_check.name: providers_payment_term_check
providers_payment_term_check.value: (payment_term IS NULL) = (payment_term_unit IS NULL) AND (payment_term IS NULL OR payment_term > 0)

purchase_order_lines_quantity_check.name: purchase_order_lines_quantity_check
purchase_order_lines_quantity_check.value: quantity > 0 AND received_quantity >= 0 AND received_quantity <= quantity

purchase_orders_amounts_check.name: purchase_orders_amounts_check
purchase_orders_amounts_check.value: subtotal >= 0 AND iva >= 0 AND total = subtotal + iva

purchase_orders_expected_check.name: purchase_orders_expected_check
purchase_orders_expected_check.value: expected_date IS NULL OR expected_date >= order_date

sale_order_lines_amounts_check.name: sale_order_lines_amounts_check
sale_order_lines_amounts_check.value: unit_price >= 0 AND discount >= 0 AND base >= 0 AND iva >= 0

sale_orders_amounts_check.name: sale_orders_amounts_check
sale_orders_amounts_check.value: subtotal >= 0 AND iva >= 0 AND total = subtotal + iva

tenants_suspension_check.name: tenants_suspension_check
tenants_suspension_check.value:
(status = 'SUSPENDED') = (suspension_reason IS NOT NULL AND suspended_at IS NOT NULL)
          AND (suspension_reason IS NULL OR suspension_reason IN ('PAYMENT_REVERSED', 'FRAUD_SUSPECTED', 'TERMS_VIOLATION', 'VOLUNTARY_CLOSURE', 'UNPAID_BALANCE', 'OTHER'))
